title: Ondine — the help desk for teams of two to fifty
description: Ondine answers the questions your customers ask most, from your own help pages, and hands the rest to a person with the whole conversation attached. Priced per seat, with no setup fee.

sections.title: Answer the same question once.
sections.lede: Ondine replies to the questions your customers ask every day, in your words, from your help pages, and passes everything else to the right person with the whole thread.

media.alt: Ondine's inbox: three answered conversations and one waiting for a person

sections.title: What changes in the first six months
sections.summary: Across 120 teams in their first six months, conversations a person had to answer fell from 1,900 a month to 780, while answered-on-their-own rose to 1,320.
sections.source: Ondine customers who started in 2025, median per team.

sections.title: The same inbox, a month apart
sections.body: Before Ondine, every refund question waited for a person. After, only the unusual ones do. Drag the divider, or use the arrow keys.

before.alt: An inbox of forty unread conversations, most of them about refunds

after.alt: The same inbox with six conversations left, each marked for a person

sections.title: What it costs your team
sections.body: Priced per person who answers customers. Ondine's own answers are included, however many there are.
sections.note: Before VAT. Cancel any month; a yearly plan is refunded for the months left.

items.name: Team
items.body: Answers from your help pages, one inbox, email and chat, and a person always one click away.

items.name: Business
items.body: Everything in Team, plus several inboxes, working hours, a sandbox to test answers, and single sign-on.

items.name: Charity
items.body: Team, free, for registered charities and schools.

items.a: Only your own help pages and the replies your team marks as good. It never answers from anything else, and it says so when it does not know.

items.q: Can customers always reach a person?
items.a: Yes. Every answer ends with a way to a person, and asking for one skips Ondine entirely.
In the EU, encrypted at rest. We never train a model on your conversations.
Most teams connect their help pages and their inbox in an afternoon, then turn answers on one topic at a time.

sections.title: See it on your own inbox
sections.body: Thirty minutes with someone who has set up a hundred of them. Bring a week of your real questions.

footer.note: Ondine is made by a team of nine in Lisbon and Ghent.
